item.title: FBI - Confetti - Review : An FBI First
item.description: I really loved this midseason premier for FBI, a lot happened but overall I think that this was a really wholesome episode. Plus we got to see Nina and Scola finally get married. This whole episode was really foreshadowing what would happen in the last scene, even the comment about an overbearing Husband. item.title: Best Medicine - The Bogfather - Review : There Is Some Darkness In Portwenn
item.description: I really loved this week’s episode of Best Medicine, it was such a heartbreaking episode but I believe it gave us so much more depth to Martin than we have ever seen before. The episode had some of it’s usual small town funny charm but this was definitely the most developmental and strong episode of the season so far.
